## Summary

Provide a concise overview of the changes made and the motivation behind them.

## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat:` New feature / enhancement
- [ ] `fix:` Bug fix
- [ ] `refactor:` Code cleanup or performance improvement
- [ ] `docs:` Documentation update
- [ ] `chore:` Build, CI/CD, or dependencies

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit` passed (0 errors)
- [ ] `pnpm run lint` passed (0 errors)
- [ ] `pnpm run build` completed successfully
- [ ] Tested responsive UI in dark and light modes
